doc.title: SALES CONTRACT
doc.preamble: {{buyer}} (hereinafter the “Buyer”), represented by its {{buyerTitle}} {{buyerDirector}}, acting under the Charter, on the one part, and {{seller}} (hereinafter the “Seller”), represented by its director {{sellerDirector}}, acting under the Charter, on the other part, jointly the “Parties”, have concluded this contract as follows:
doc.s1p1: The Seller undertakes to supply to the Buyer “{{product}}” in the quantity of {{qty}} {{unit}}, and the Buyer undertakes to accept and pay for it on the terms of this contract.
doc.s1p2: The name, quantity, quality and price of the goods are set out in the Specification (Annex No. 1), which forms an integral part of this contract.
doc.s1p3: This contract is concluded on the basis of purchase request No. {{tender}} on the “Bozor-Analitika” platform and the Seller’s commercial offer.
doc.s2p1: The unit price is {{unitPrice}} UZS; the value of the goods is {{goods}} UZS.
doc.s2p2Included: Delivery costs are included in the price of the goods and borne by the Seller.
doc.s2p3: The total contract amount is {{total}} UZS{{words}}, excluding VAT.
doc.s2p4: The price of the goods does not change during the term of the contract.
doc.s3Prepay: Within 3 (three) banking days of signing, the Buyer transfers a prepayment of {{pct}}%, i.e. {{amount}} UZS.
doc.s3RestAfter: The remaining {{amount}} UZS is paid within {{days}} banking days of full acceptance of the goods.
doc.s3OnDelivery: Payment of {{amount}} UZS is made within 3 (three) banking days of full acceptance of the goods.
doc.s3Deferred: Payment of {{amount}} UZS is made within {{days}} calendar days of full acceptance of the goods.
doc.s3Transfer: Payments are made by bank transfer to the Seller’s account. The payment date is the date the funds leave the Buyer’s account.
doc.s4p1: The Seller delivers the goods by {{date}} (within {{days}} calendar days of signing) to: {{address}}.
doc.s4p2Included: Delivery and unloading are at the Seller’s expense.
doc.s4p2Paid: Delivery costs {{price}} UZS and is included in the total amount.
doc.s4p3: Goods are handed over against a waybill and an electronic invoice. Title and the risk of accidental loss pass to the Buyer upon acceptance.
doc.s4p4: Latest date required by the Buyer: {{date}}.
doc.s5p1: The goods must meet the “{{quality}}” grade and the standards and technical specifications in force in the Republic of Uzbekistan.
doc.s5p2: On acceptance the Buyer checks quantity and quality. Any discrepancy is recorded in a statement drawn up with representatives of both Parties within 3 (three) working days.
doc.s5NoWarranty: No warranty period is set; hidden defects are handled in accordance with the law.
doc.s6p1: For late delivery the Seller pays a penalty of {{pct}}% of the value of undelivered goods per day of delay, capped at {{cap}}% of that value.
doc.s6p2: For late payment the Buyer pays a penalty of {{pct}}% of the unpaid amount per day of delay, capped at {{cap}}% of that amount.
doc.s6p3: Payment of a penalty does not release the Parties from their obligations.
doc.s7p1: The Parties are not liable for failure to perform caused by force majeure (natural disasters, epidemics, hostilities, decisions of public authorities, etc.).
doc.s7p2: The affected Party notifies the other Party in writing within 5 (five) calendar days.
doc.s8p1: Disputes under this contract are settled by negotiation. The period for answering a claim is 10 (ten) calendar days.
doc.s8p2: Failing agreement, the dispute is heard by the economic court under the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
doc.s9p1: The contract enters into force when both Parties have signed it with an electronic digital signature and remains in force until all obligations are fulfilled.
doc.s9p2: The contract is made as an electronic document. Amendments are valid only when signed by both Parties.
